topNews.text: Drug Used to Treat Asthma and Allergies May Also Help Fight Aggressive Cancers
topNews.excerpt: A drug often used to treat asthma and allergies may also help fight aggressive cancers, according to new US research. The study revealed how tumors hijack common white blood cells to evade immunotherapy.
